text.en: These rules may be cited as the Second-hand Dealers Rules. Citation

In these rules -Interpre"the Act" means the Second-hand Dealers Act; Cap. 65 "certificate of exemption" means the form of exemption from the provisions of the Act issued by the licensing officer under the provisions of section 4 of the Act; "Purchase Ledger" means the book containing particulars of goods purchased required to be kept by a licensed dealer by virtue of the provisions of paragraph (a) of subsection (1) of section 9 of the Act; "Sales Ledger" means the book containing particulars of goods sold required to be kept by a licensed dealer by virtue of the provisions of paragraph (b) of subsection {1) of section 9 of the Act; "Second-hand dealers licence" means the licence issued to a dealer in second-hand goods under the provisions of paragraph (a) of section 8 of the Act.

CONDITIONS TO BE INDORSED ON THE BACK OF A SECOND/HAND DEALERS LICENCE

(1) The licensee will not knowingly deal in any stolen property.

(2) This licence shall be kept posted up in a conspicuous place in the licensee's shop, over the outer door of which shall also be exhibited an approved sign-board.

(3) The licensee shall not sell or purchase goods before 7.00 a.m. or after 9.00 p.m.

(4) The licensee shall keep the prescribed books which shall be produced on demand between 7.00 a.m. and 9.00-p.m. to any magistrate, the Licensing Officer, or any Police Officer not below the rank of Sergeant, or the Police Officer authorised in writing by the Licensing Officer.

(5) The licensee shall without unnecessary delay give information to the Police of any stolen property offered for sale, and may detain any person offering such for sale until the arrival of the Police. He will be supplied in return by the Police with lists of stolen property.

(6) The licensee shall admit any Police Officer not below the rank of Sergeant or any Police Officer authorised in writing by the Licensing Officer, to his premises to search for stolen property at any time. ·- B,L.R.O. 111984 FOURTH SCHEDULE (Rule 8)
